selection_rule: the first 60 questions, in the original frozen randomized candidate order, whose four contexts are approved with observed_state equal to the intended state; no model outcome influences the selection and the candidate order is unchanged

sensitivity_subset.purpose: predeclared sensitivity analysis on the same runs; no additional provider calls
sensitivity_subset.reason: these questions entered the sample through the stage 13 conventions G-1 (identifier granularity) and K-1 (kinship and spouse slots), or through an ordinary-reading call on a CLEAN context; the sensitivity subset re-runs the same analysis on the remaining questions using the same runs
